decision: Do not continue the old R79B lesson field standard. Build the next lesson schema mapping from R79A through this R80 adapter.

lesson_fields.label: 课时身份
lesson_fields.generation_role: name grade, unit, lesson, page, period, and material scope

lesson_fields.label: 教材锚点
lesson_fields.generation_role: locate textbook pages, images, exercises, and source gaps

lesson_fields.label: 本课概念切片
lesson_fields.generation_role: select this lesson's slice of the unit concept

lesson_fields.label: 本课驱动问题
lesson_fields.generation_role: convert unit essential question into a teachable lesson question

lesson_fields.label: 课时目标
lesson_fields.generation_role: make lesson outcomes observable and assessable

lesson_fields.label: 学生起点
lesson_fields.generation_role: state what students can already notice or do and what blocks them

lesson_fields.label: 重难点
lesson_fields.generation_role: separate teaching focus and difficulty at lesson scale

lesson_fields.label: 本课任务与证据
lesson_fields.generation_role: define what students make, say, compare, revise, or submit

lesson_fields.label: 教学过程
lesson_fields.generation_role: generate step contracts before line-level edits

lesson_fields.label: 学习单/学生任务单计划
lesson_fields.generation_role: derive student-facing sheet from activity and evidence

lesson_fields.label: 评价计划
lesson_fields.generation_role: match evidence, criteria, and feedback moments

lesson_fields.label: 资料补充
lesson_fields.generation_role: ask for missing textbook, image, student work, or schedule evidence

reuse_foundations.name: current page carrier

reuse_foundations.name: candidate to existing edit-card bridge
